source_caption_text:
🔥 FRANCE IS BURNING 🔥 It started with high school kids in the Paris suburbs, tired of missing teachers, packed classrooms, and 10-hour school days. They barricaded their schools, and the government sent riot cops. Over 6,000 arrests, most of them kids under 18. Then the grown folks joined in over the cost of living, and on Saturday more than half a million people hit the streets 😳 Masked rioters stormed a 150-year-old city hall in Limoges, threw firebombs inside, and the roof caved in. In Paris, the base of the Marianne statue, France's version of the Statue of Liberty, got torn apart. Stores were looted in Paris, Marseille, Lyon, and Bordeaux. More than 1,800 people were arrested in one weekend and over 500 officers and firefighters were hurt 🚨 Macron blames the far left, the far left blames the government, and Trump says it's immigration. And the kids who started it all still don't have their teachers. 🤔 Were the students right, or did the rioters ruin it? Drop your take below 👇 Full story on my YouTube, Ceddy Nash. Link in bio 🎥
#France #FranceIsBurning #Paris #FranceProtests #Riots
